One minor note: a malformed file skill is reported in the model's wording.

findings.title: A malformed `skill` in a file is reported in the model's wording, not the file's
findings.detail:
withSkillLists maps only a string `skill`, then validates against the model. So `skill: ''` is reported as `/steps/a/skills/0: must NOT have fewer than 1 characters`, a key the file does not have. `skill: 5` or `skill: [a]` is reported as `/steps/a: unknown property 'skill'`, which wrongly suggests the key itself is unknown. Before this change, both cases named `/steps/a/skill` with a type or length message. Reproduced by calling parseWorkflowText on those three snippets.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Map any present `skill` to `skills`, or check the file wording (type and length of `skill`) before the model validation, so errors keep naming `/steps/<s>/skill`. Slice 04 changes the file wording anyway and may fold this in.
